    print(value, '\\t', label)
print('\\ncase summaries')
for case in cond['cases']:
    value=case['value']
    names=[]
    def walk(inputs, prefix=''):
        for inp in inputs:
            if inp.get('type')=='conditional':
                names.append(prefix+inp['name']+'<conditional>')
                for c in inp.get('cases',[]): walk(c.get('inputs',[]), prefix+inp['name']+'.'+c.get('value','')+'.')

                names.append(prefix+inp.get('name','?')+':'+inp.get('type','?'))
    walk(case.get('inputs',[]))
    print(value, names[:20])
